subject: Cloud Computing
title: Pushing Secrets to GitHub
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Pushing Secrets to GitHub.

hook.text: A developer commits an AWS key to a public GitHub repo. Within minutes, crypto miners spin up $50,000 in EC2 instances.

buildup.text: Bots scan every public GitHub commit in real-time looking for cloud credentials. Detection takes seconds.

discovery.text: GitHub now scans for secrets automatically and alerts users. AWS can revoke exposed keys within minutes.

twist.text: Even after rotation, the damage may be done. Attackers may have already exfiltrated data or planted backdoors.

climax.text: Pre-commit hooks that block secrets from ever reaching the repository are the only reliable prevention.

punchline.text: Bots find leaked keys in seconds. Pre-commit hooks stop the leak.

quiz.question: How quickly can attackers exploit leaked cloud credentials on GitHub?
options: Within minutes, using bots that scan every public commit in real-time
It typically takes weeks for anyone to notice leaked credentials
Leaked credentials are automatically invalid and cannot be used

details.summary: Developers accidentally push API keys, database passwords, and cloud credentials to GitHub repositories daily. Automated scanners harvest exposed secrets within minutes. Major breaches at Uber, Samsung, and Toyota have all originated from secrets committed to version control.
details.whyItMatters: Secrets in source code are one of the most common and preventable cloud security failures. A single exposed credential can compromise an entire cloud environment.
takeaways: Automated bots harvest exposed secrets within minutes
Major companies have been breached via committed credentials
Pre-commit hooks and secret scanning prevent exposure

faq.question: How quickly are exposed secrets exploited?
faq.answer: Research shows that valid AWS keys pushed to public GitHub repositories are discovered and used within minutes, sometimes seconds. Automated bots continuously scan new commits for patterns matching API keys, passwords, and tokens across all public repositories.

faq.question: How can accidental secret commits be prevented?
faq.answer: Use pre-commit hooks that scan for secrets before they enter version control. Enable GitHub's secret scanning and push protection. Store secrets in environment variables or secret managers, never in code. Rotate any secret that was ever committed, even briefly.
